verdict.rationale: First-party docs say cfo.ai brings in Actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or Rillet, with no manual export step. The connection refreshes nightly and can be synced on demand ('Sync now' or by asking Ari). Users can also stop a running sync and re-import past months after fixing their books, and the model is rebuilt overnight off the close. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sync, and Xero- and NetSuite-specific setup and mapping detail (only QuickBooks is named in the sync docs).
